text:
Maria G.: ok team — sprint idea: 'Harbor' pilot to marry starter credits + a short onboarding drip + a single demo webinar. goal: lift 7-day retained usage and first-5-requests rate. thinking 2k new signups cohort, random 50% holdout. :anchor:
AJ: nice. what's the timing? and how many credits are we seeding?
Maria G.: timeline: kickoff Mon, run for 2 weeks, evaluate by day 14. credits: 40 free tokens (~starter pack) + 1 webinar seat invite in email 2.
Sandeep R.: inbound routing question — are these folks coming from ad channels or organic? we should tag source for routing to SDR follow-up.
Tess (growth): 60/40 organic:paid split expected from the funnel. we'll add utm params and a signup flag `harbor_pilot=true`.
Katie L.: i'll draft 3 short email copy variants: 1) product-first, 2) prompt-templates highlight, 3) benchmark narrative (fast vs default). will post tomorrow.
Nate (eng): for instrumentation i need an event list. propose: `signup.harbor`, `email.clicked`, `webinar.rsvp`, `first_request`, `request.count_5`.
Maria G.: perfect. Nate can you add the `harbor_pilot` flag on signup and a user property `starter_credits_granted`?
Nate (eng): yes. planned event payloads in this PR:```
{
  "event": "signup.harbor",
  "user_id": "<id>",
  "utm_source": "<src>",
  "harbor_pilot": true
}
```
Nate (eng): will also add a lightweight webhook for credit grant so Marketing can verify counts.
Katie L.: creative ask — we need a tidy image and 1min webinar hero gif. Sandeep can you confirm legal on promo language for credits?
Sandeep R.: legal ok with 'free starter credits for new signups' but no dollar equivalence. also need audit log for grants.
Tess (growth): measuring: primary = % users with >=5 requests in 7 days; secondary = % who attend webinar and conversion to paid in 30 days. will set up dashboards.
AJ: quick note on segmentation — can we prioritize users with intent signals (repo imports, api key created) in the experiment to boost signal?
Maria G.: yes, let's include an intent bucket: `high_intent=true` (30% expected). we'll randomize within intent strata.
ops-bot: Calendar invite created: Harbor Pilot Sync — Mon 10am. Link: https://calendar.redwood/harbor-pilot-sync
Katie L.: pulling draft email 1 into #marketing-drafts: https://redwood.internal/drafts/harbor-email1 — feedback welcome.
Tess (growth): also adding a small survey on day 3 for pilot users: 3 quick Qs about friction, output quality, and what they'd build next. short link in email 2.
Maria G.: action items: Katie — finalize copy and hero (EOD Fri). Nate — instrumentation + webhook (Mon). Sandeep — audit & legal stamp (Mon). Tess — dashboard + survey (Mon). AJ — sample sizing and analysis plan (Mon). I'll run rollout and monitor. :rocket:
AJ: ack. will ping once sample calc done.
Sandeep R.: noted. will need a CSV of grants for audit. Nate — can webhook include `grant_reason: \"harbor_pilot\"`?
Nate (eng): yup. webhook will include `grant_reason`.
Katie L.: quick A/B idea — include 3 prompt templates in onboarding vs none. that'll test prompt-led activation. adding as a variant.
Tess (growth): good call. track variant `prompt_templates=true|false`.
Maria G.: love it. final ask — keep subject lines tight, no more than 45 chars for mobile.
AJ: :thumbsup:
Maria G.: thanks everyone — i'll post the final experiment doc after the sync.
ops-bot: Reminder: deploy window Tue 1am-3am UTC. schedule accordingly. :calendar:
